title: Pulling money without my consent
body:
UPD: Problem was solved and all money returned. Thanks to involment of my bank. 🚨 WARNING: Ultiself Daily Routine Planner Is Pulling Money from My Card Without Consent! 🚨

I signed up for Ultiself with the promise of a plan—no subscription required—yet they’ve charged my debit card three times over four months: €14.31, €70.00, and €68.55.

At first, I didn’t unotice. But once I did, I immediately blocked my card and contacted my bank to dispute these unauthorized withdrawals. I feel completely cheated.
